CustomField.label: Primary Query (SOQL)
CustomField.description: The SOQL that fetches what you are checking. Use merge tokens like {!Id} or {!AccountNumber} to insert values from the current record. Leave blank only when using the List includes any of / List excludes all of operators; use Value To Test (list checks only) for the value to compare against the Second Query list.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: SOQL that returns the data to check. Insert record values with {!Id}, {!FieldApiName}, etc. Use COUNT() for "how many" checks.
